_comment: Cross-language parity fixture for the single-line secret-value shape SSOT (v0.2.80 Part A). Consumed by THREE runners that MUST agree: (Python) tests/test_secret_value_shape.py against vco_lib.secret_value_shape; (Rust) a #[test] in launcher/src-tauri/src/commands/secrets_import.rs against the Rust predicate mirror; (bash) tools/vct-secrets/tests/test_vct.sh against the vct::_is_single_line_secret mirror. Python is the SSOT (A>B>C); the fixture locks bash+Rust to it. A divergence in any mirror fails that language's parity leg. NEVER put a real secret here — every value is obviously fake.
_note: A '\n' in a JSON string is a LITERAL newline in the decoded value (all of Python json, serde_json, and jq/bash decode it identically). Cases exercise the classifier's default settings (allow_multiline=false). Each case: name, value (the secret), key_name (empty unless the case needs the github_pat length heuristic), expect_ok (bool from is_single_line_secret), expect_reason (reason slug; empty string when ok), expect_taxonomy (classify_secret_value tag: ok | legit_multiline | blob | length_corruption).

cases.name: pem_private_key_legit
cases.value:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

cases.name: unicode_ls_u2028_not_a_line_boundary_in_pem
cases.value:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIE AAAA
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
cases._why: U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR must NOT be treated as a line boundary (only \n/\r/\r\n are). All three languages must agree: BEGIN is line 0, END is the last line -> legit PEM. Python's str.splitlines() would over-split on U+2028 and disagree with the Rust/bash mirrors; this case locks that gap (v0.2.80 adversarial-review finding N1).

cases.name: unicode_ps_u2029_inside_blob_key_eq_value
cases._why: A real \n splits line 0 (tok) from a column-0 KEY= line; the U+2029 inside the value is not a boundary. Blob rejected identically on all three.

cases.name: unicode_nel_u0085_no_real_newline_is_single_line
cases._why: U+0085 NEL with no \n/\r is a single-line value on all three (str.splitlines would wrongly split it; the mirrors don't).
